'''P'Dar'Ken''' was the sovereign [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], inhabited by the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]]. It was hit directly by an asteroid when the planet was devastated during the Corellian-Aqualish war.
